workarounds.symptom: spawn_continue on a running follow-up's own id starts a second turn
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(subagent): refuse a running follow-up's own id as conversation_busy. Target files: src/kiro_crew/subagent_manager/continuation.py, test/test_subagent_continuable.py, docs/system-specs/modules/subagent.md. `spawn_continue` takes a conversation id. `ContinuationCoordinator` checks that conversation for a run in flight with `_conversation_busy("subagent:<id>")`, in `continue_conversation_async_impl` and again in `_continue_prelude_impl`. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/41483)

workarounds.symptom: pod: a pod named `nul` (or another Windows device name) passes validate_name, and `pod up` then gives worktree advice git cannot follow on Windows
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(pod): refuse a windows device name for a new pod. Target files: src/kiro_crew/pod/cli.py, src/kiro_crew/pod/runtime.py, test/test_pod.py. **Goal:** A new pod can no longer be named after a Windows device such as `nul`: `kirocrew pod up` and `kirocrew pod provision` refuse it with the existing `invalid pod name` error, on every host. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/41255)

workarounds.symptom: Changing a chat's project folder answers 403 "Access denied" (audit "sensitive path") for a healthy folder during a resolver stall; realpath and isdir also run on the loop
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(dashboard): accept a healthy project folder during a resolver stall. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_api/session_relaunch.py, test/test_chat_slot_project.py, test/test_slot_identity_continue_project.py. **Goal:** Changing a chat's project folder accepts a healthy folder while the path resolver is cooling down after a stall, instead of refusing it with "Access denied". (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/41001)

workarounds.symptom: Flaky: test_dashboard_template_keeps_namespace_through_real_manager[full_spec_host-restore] on Windows
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: commit a targeted rehydrate's tab-id backfill before returning. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_persistence.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_persistence_parts/restore_drivers.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_persistence_parts/slot_builders.py. **Goal:** A dashboard chat restored from history by a targeted rehydrate runs its next turn instead of being refused with "session changed during admission", and the `restore` case of `test_dashboard_template_keeps_namespace_through_real_manager` stops going red on... (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/40913)

workarounds.symptom: kirocrew doctor stops at Credentials when it cannot check ~/.aws
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(doctor): finish the report when ~/.aws cannot be checked. Target files: src/kiro_crew/doctor_checks/access.py, test/test_doctor_credentials.py. **Goal:** `kirocrew doctor` finishes its report, and tells the truth about the AWS setup, when the host will not let it check `~/.aws`. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/40670)

workarounds.symptom: Setup's sandbox step on Ubuntu 24.04 says only MCP tooling is off, but no agent can run
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(setup): say no agent can run on a host the sandbox refuses. Target files: src/kiro_crew/cli_setup.py, test/test_cli_setup.py, test/test_sandbox_unsandboxed_exec_consent.py. **Goal:** On a Linux host whose sandbox refuses every agent, such as a stock Ubuntu 24.04 machine with its AppArmor user-namespace restriction, `kirocrew setup` says that no agent can run yet, names `kirocrew service install` as the fix, and does not end with "Done!". (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/40871)

workarounds.symptom: Prompt optimizer starts and kills a kirocrew-lite runtime on every call, so under load the cold start uses up its 30 s budget and the draft comes back unchanged
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(optimizer): stop a slow session start returning the draft unchanged. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/optimizer.py, test/test_optimizer.py, docs/system-specs/modules/prompt-optimizer.md. **Goal:** Optimize prompt returns the rewritten draft when its session is slow to start, instead of handing the draft back unchanged after 30 s. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/40543)

workarounds.symptom: fix: a Bot worker never learns its monitor arm was refused or its stop applied
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: tell a bot worker when its monitor arm or stop did not land. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/session_directive_apply.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/session_directive_apply_outcome.py, src/kiro_crew/mcp_tools/control_parts/monitor.py. **Goal:** A Bot's worker session always learns whether its monitor arm or stop actually landed, so it never reports a watch it does not have. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/40467)

workarounds.symptom: Windows: a saved KAS MCP sign-in read that races another engine's token save fails with "MCP grant store error"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(secrets): retry a vault read that meets a Windows replace. Target files: src/kiro_crew/secrets/vault.py, test/test_secrets_vault_windows_read_retry.py. **Goal:** On Windows, a KAS engine's read of a saved MCP sign-in no longer fails with "MCP grant store error" when another engine saves a token at the same moment. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/35521)

workarounds.symptom: CI: Docs Contract Tests (1) fails on dubious ownership after run-as-runner
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(ci): run docs-contract-tests' root steps before the run-as-runner hand-over. Target files: .github/workflows/ci.yml, test/test_ci_nonroot_boundary.py. **Goal:** Docs Contract Tests passes on a docs-only pull request, so the docs-only fast path from #39919 can actually reach a green `PR Readiness`. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/40027)

workarounds.symptom: Flaky: test_timeline_refuses_rows_from_a_second_succession_unit leaks a crew-log writer lease on Windows
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(apps): answer the store listing within 5 s while app.json fetches run. Target files: src/kiro_crew/apps/registry.py, src/kiro_crew/apps/registry_pipeline/caches.py, src/kiro_crew/apps/registry_pipeline/catalog.py. **Goal:** Opening an app from Discover takes a few seconds, not a minute or more, even when many registry rows' `app.json` fetches are slow or failing. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/39960)

workarounds.symptom: Persistent cron run refused learn_add as restricted_session: legacy dashboard_cron-<id>.jsonl beside cron_<id>.jsonl makes _probe_persisted_session call the key ambiguous
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(memory): a cron transcript pair that agrees on its mode keeps that mode. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/_shared_session_memory.py, src/kiro_crew/messaging/upload_gate.py, test/test_ephemeral_sessions_recognition.py. **Goal:** A persistent cron job can save lessons again when an old `dashboard_cron-<id>.jsonl` transcript sits beside its `cron_<id>.jsonl`. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/39232)

workarounds.symptom: Browser ops fail on main: snapshot walker is over the Harness daemon's 64 KiB line limit
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(browser): send the walker under the harness daemon's 64 KiB line. Target files: src/kiro_crew/browser_harness/ops.py, test/test_browser_change_report.py, test/test_browser_guard_isolated_count.py. **Goal:** The agent's browser opens and reads pages again on main: `navigate`, `snapshot` and every other op that reads the page work. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/39779)

workarounds.symptom: The browser callback page does not name the reason the provider gave
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(auth): name the provider's reason on the failed sign-in tab. Target files: src/kiro_crew/auth/login/portal.py, test/test_kas_login_loopback.py, docs/system-specs/modules/kas-auth.md. **Goal:** When the sign-in page sends the browser back with an error, the browser tab says the reason the provider gave instead of a bare "Login failed". (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/36706)

workarounds.symptom: In a container limited to 2 GB, memory posture is permanently critical: background helpers are refused and the sub-agent gate stays paused
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: warn at start-up when a container limit pins memory at critical. Target files: src/kiro_crew/config/sections_agent.py, src/kiro_crew/resource_status_container_limit.py, src/kiro_crew/slack/gateway_runtime/process_entry.py. **Goal:** A gateway running in a container whose memory limit is at or under `agent.resource_critical_gb` says so once at start-up and names the settings to lower. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/38371)

workarounds.symptom: Gateway start with root-owned data files ends in a lock error, not the ownership message
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: say who owns the data home when a gateway start is refused. Target files: src/kiro_crew/cli.py, src/kiro_crew/cli_gateway_boot.py, src/kiro_crew/data_home_owner.py. **Goal:** A `kirocrew gateway` start that stops because data-home files belong to another account says so, with the troubleshooting link, instead of ending on a bare lock or "cannot persist" error. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/38648)

workarounds.symptom: Relay viewer: prod Team Crews are never listed (ListCrewEndpoints is sent without profileArn, ACCESS_DENIED)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(relay-viewer): send the sign-in's profileArn when listing Crews. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/relay_viewer.py, src/kiro_crew/relay_viewer/cps.py, test/test_relay_viewer_cps.py. **Goal:** A signed-in teammate sees the Team Crews they were granted in the desktop app's Crew list. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/38967)

workarounds.symptom: KAS MCP launcher on Windows launches a bare `shutil.which` result, so a working-directory file can shadow the server command
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(transcribe): probe ffmpeg candidate folders inside the folder. Target files: src/kiro_crew/transcribe.py, test/test_transcribe_ffmpeg.py. **Goal:** On Windows, `ensure_ffmpeg_in_path` adds a candidate folder to `PATH` only when that folder actually holds ffmpeg. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/38802)

workarounds.symptom: `policy explain --batch -` decodes piped stdin in the ANSI code page on Windows, so a UTF-8 BOM or non-ASCII item is mis-read
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(policy): decode piped explain --batch stdin as UTF-8 (#38491). Target files: src/kiro_crew/cli_commands_security.py, test/test_policy_explain_batch_bom.py, docs/system-specs/modules/governance.md. **Goal:** `kirocrew policy explain --batch -` reads piped UTF-8 requests the same way `--batch FILE` does, so a BOM or a non-ASCII item is answered correctly on Windows. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/38826)

workarounds.symptom: kirocrew CLI and snapshot messages lead with emoji; use plain words
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): print plain words instead of emoji in setup, config and server. Target files: src/kiro_crew/cli.py, src/kiro_crew/cli_chat.py, src/kiro_crew/cli_chat_context.py. **Goal:** `kirocrew setup`, `config`, the server lifecycle commands, `kas`, `chat` and the top-level CLI print plain words instead of emoji. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/38834)

workarounds.symptom: Slack messages lead with emoji and :shortcodes:; use plain words
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: drop emoji from non-slack channel messages. Target files: src/kiro_crew/discord/commands.py, src/kiro_crew/discord/renderer.py, src/kiro_crew/discord/renderer_live.py. **Goal:** Messages that Telegram, Discord, Teams, Webex, WeCom, Weixin, Feishu, iMessage and WhatsApp send say what they mean in words, with no emoji. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/38815)

workarounds.symptom: Diagnose probe `remote_crew_unreachable` cannot read a Windows-authored `instances.json` that the registry itself accepts
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(diagnose): read instances.json as the registry does in the remote-crew probe. Target files: src/kiro_crew/diagnose_probes.py, test/test_diagnose_probes.py. **Goal:** Diagnose names a down Remote Crew even when `instances.json` is saved with a byte-order mark or as UTF-16. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/38753)

workarounds.symptom: Cloud crew bootstrap prints 'line 161: --: command not found' on every launch
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(desktop): escape the backticked path in the Linux smoke heredoc. Target files: scripts/smoke-linux-packages.sh, test/test_smoke_linux_packages_asserts.py. **Goal:** Linux package smoke runs stop printing a spurious "No such file or directory" and keep the full comment text in the assertions they generate. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/38217)

workarounds.symptom: kirocrew update: CLI fetch still has a hard 60s timeout and leaves tmp_pack files (the gap #33828 left)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(updates): give kirocrew update the update check fetch deadline and reaper. Target files: src/kiro_crew/cli_server.py, src/kiro_crew/cli_server_update.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/updates.py. **Goal:** `kirocrew update` on a source checkout far behind main can finish its fetch, and a killed fetch no longer leaves temp packs behind. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/38149)

workarounds.symptom: template.update card always fails 'changed on disk': crewmate templates are found in mates/agents but re-read against agents only
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(dashboard): re-read a crewmate template from the folder it was found in. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/agent_admin/agent_detail.py, test/test_agent_detail_crewmate_reread.py, test/requires-real-symlinks.txt. **Goal:** A `template.update` card applies to a crewmate template instead of always failing with "changed on disk". (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/38186)

workarounds.symptom: Windows desktop: native log redaction fails with EPERM on every launch, so Chromium file logging stays off and chromium.log is never redacted
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(desktop): release the log descriptor before redaction replaces it on Windows. Target files: website/electron/native-logging.js, website/electron/test/native-logging.test.js. **Goal:** On Windows, the desktop app's native log redaction replaces `chromium.log` without error, so rotation completes and Chromium file logging comes back on. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/37850)

workarounds.symptom: CI: fork PR jobs fail on the kirocrew-linux-4-core runner's new ubuntu-26.04 image (Playwright install, codex sandbox tests)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(terminal): withdraw the readiness hook from a PROMPT_COMMAND array. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/terminal.py, test/test_terminal_handler_pty_integration.py, test/test_terminal_handler_session_state.py. **Goal:** On systemd hosts, the dashboard terminal's one-shot readiness hook removes itself from `PROMPT_COMMAND` after the first prompt, as it already does elsewhere. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/37697)

workarounds.symptom: Bot capabilities fail with invalid_spec when the agent spec has a knowledgeBase resource
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(capabilities): carry a knowledge-base resource as its own row. Target files: src/kiro_crew/agent_capabilities.py, src/kiro_crew/agent_capabilities_resources.py, src/kiro_crew/agent_state.py. **Goal:** A bot whose template agent spec declares a knowledge base in `resources` can be managed in Customize > Bots, and its copy keeps that knowledge base. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/37690)

workarounds.symptom: Task completed notice shows ❌ on skipped steps, more than its own failed count
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(taskrunner): show each step's own status icon in completion notice. Target files: src/kiro_crew/task_reporter.py, test/test_taskrunner_verification.py, docs/system-specs/modules/taskrunner.md. **Goal:** `The "✅ Task completed" notice marks a skipped, cancelled or never-started step with its own icon instead of ❌.` (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/35183)

workarounds.symptom: ci: Render Benchmark (counter budgets) fails on main: Playwright cannot install chromium on the ubuntu-26.04 runner image
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(acp): a fresh chat joins the process a restarted founder mounted its tree on. Target files: src/kiro_crew/providers/chat_share.py, src/kiro_crew/runtime_ownership.py, test/test_chat_runtime_sharing_cleanup.py. **Goal:** after a gateway restart, a team lead and the workers it opens share one KAS process again under ACP runtime sharing. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/37639)

workarounds.symptom: Sandbox refusal under a sandbox.min_level floor tells a host with agent.sandbox_allow_unsandboxed_exec=false to set it to true, which the floor ignores
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sandbox): name the min_level floor when it refuses a backendless spawn. Target files: src/kiro_crew/sandbox_unavailable.py, src/kiro_crew/sandbox_wrap.py, test/test_sandbox_first_party_exec.py. **Goal:** On a governed host, a backendless-spawn refusal names the `sandbox.min_level` floor that actually forbids the spawn instead of pointing the operator at the powerless `agent.sandbox_allow_unsandboxed_exec` key. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/33447)

workarounds.symptom: opencode with no provider answers chats from its own hosted model without notice
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(opencode): stop a chat that would fall back to opencode's hosted model. Target files: src/kiro_crew/acp/client_model_selection.py, src/kiro_crew/acp/client_start.py, src/kiro_crew/acp/harness/base.py. **Goal:** an opencode chat on a host with no model provider is stopped with a notice that names the fix, instead of quietly answering from opencode's own hosted model, and a refused key shows the fix instead of a raw error. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/37480)

workarounds.symptom: [Windows] Auto-update 0.12.1 -> 0.12.2 fails deterministically on long bundled paths and can leave the install broken (gateway: "No module named kiro_crew.__main__")
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(installer): clear or refuse files too deep for the old uninstaller to move. Target files: packaging/check_windows_path_budget.py, .github/scripts/test-windows-installer.ps1, .github/workflows/build.yml. **Goal:** A Windows update over an install with very long file paths finishes, and an update that cannot finish leaves the installed version working. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/36067)

workarounds.symptom: Dashboard Stop button does not cancel in-flight subagents
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(dashboard): mark subagent cards as 'parent stopped' on Stop. Target files: website/src/store/chat/runState.ts, website/src/store/chat/subagents.ts, website/src/store/chatSlice.ts. **Goal:** After the dashboard Stop button ends a turn, its still-running subagent cards say their parent stopped instead of spinning as if nothing happened. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/23604)

workarounds.symptom: Windows: a transient read failure on denied_commands.json drops the user's added deny rules and folds to an empty state
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(hooks): keep the last user deny rules when denied_commands.json cannot be read. Target files: src/kiro_crew/config/loosening_provenance.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/security.py, src/kiro_crew/hook_runtime/denied_commands.py. **Goal:** A read error on `denied_commands.json` no longer drops the user's own deny rules from the command gate. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/34188)

workarounds.symptom: claude: the model-substitution retry re-sends the restricted model on a cold model cache
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(acp): seed the substitute model on a cold cache when retrying. Target files: src/kiro_crew/acp/client_claude_seed.py, src/kiro_crew/acp/client_start.py, test/test_acp_client_model_substitution.py. **Goal:** When the pinned Claude model is restricted, the retry that adopts the backend's substitute model actually runs on that substitute, so sessions start instead of failing every time. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/36952)

workarounds.symptom: kirocrew cron preview ends in a traceback on a symlink-loop or too-long script path
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: refuse a cron preview script path the resolver cannot follow. Target files: src/kiro_crew/cli_commands_cron.py, test/test_cron_preview_cmd.py. **Goal:** `kirocrew cron preview` refuses a script path the resolver cannot follow with one line and exit 1, as `kirocrew cron add` already does, instead of a traceback. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/36988)

workarounds.symptom: desktop: a managed update apply never logs the command's pid, outcome, run time or output, and a timeout reads as "exited 1"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(desktop): log a managed update apply's pid, outcome and run time. Target files: website/electron/runtime/update/armed-apply.js, website/electron/runtime/update/managed-exec.js, website/electron/test/managed-apply-log.test.js. **Goal:** A managed update apply leaves enough in `gateway-launch.log` to diagnose a slow, failed or timed-out run, and a timeout is reported as a timeout. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/36889)

workarounds.symptom: Task queue: a huge Retry-After makes a retryable 503 fail at once
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(taskq): keep the retry when a retry hint is too large to use. Target files: src/kiro_crew/taskq/adapters/acp_provider.py, src/kiro_crew/taskq/adapters/http.py, test/test_dependency_signals.py. **Goal:** A retryable 503 or 429 whose retry hint is no usable time still gets retried on its normal schedule, instead of failing at once or waiting forever. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/35962)

workarounds.symptom: Sessions sidebar offers one-click Resume for sessions interrupted months ago (no age limit on the interrupted count)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: leave week-old interrupted sessions out of the bulk Resume. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_resume_all.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/slot_projection.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/state.py. **Goal:** The Sessions sidebar stops offering to restart chats whose last turn was cut short more than a week ago. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/35861)

workarounds.symptom: Codex commands fail inside Linux namespace sandbox despite working AppArmor profile
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: run codex within the existing host sandbox. Target files: src/kiro_crew/acp/client_permissions.py, src/kiro_crew/acp/harness/codex.py, src/kiro_crew/acp/session_handle_permissions.py. > Taken over by @buluoray to drive it green (rebased on main, fallback added, re-verified). Original work and design by @brentlee-personal, credited with `Co-authored-by`. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/29127)

workarounds.symptom: Script cron: spawn_run through ctx.call_tool is refused with 409 memory_unavailable (a cron:<id> key never gets a published memory mode)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cron): admit a script cron's key for its spawn calls during the run. Target files: src/kiro_crew/slack/gateway_runtime/cron_fire.py, test/test_cron_script_spawn_memory_mode.py, docs/system-specs/modules/learn-cron-dashboard.md. **Goal:** A script cron can start subagents with `ctx.call_tool("kirocrew-core", "spawn_run", ...)`, the same way a message cron's turn can. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/35175)

workarounds.symptom: Loading the embedding model silences the whole process: the --json-ready line and log lines are lost
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: load the embedding model without silencing the process. Target files: src/kiro_crew/embeddings.py, src/kiro_crew/embeddings_native.py, src/kiro_crew/mcp_shared_wire.py. **Goal:** Loading the embedding model no longer silences the rest of the process, so the gateway's `--json-ready` line, log lines and tracebacks written meanwhile always arrive. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/35444)

workarounds.symptom: cli.sh on a nearly full disk: no free-space check, fails with a raw ensurepip error, and leaves 120 MB behind
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(install): check free space first and remove a failed first venv. Target files: cli.sh, test/test_installer_disk_space.py, test/test_installer_distro.py. **Goal:** On a nearly full disk, the one-line install stops before it downloads anything with a plain "not enough space" message, says the disk filled up in plain words when a step still runs out of room, and leaves no half-built venv behind. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/35216)

workarounds.symptom: deepseek: lower-case agent.deepseek_env names pass the reserved-name refusal on Windows
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: tighten a harness environment name check on windows. Target files: src/kiro_crew/acp/harness/deepseek.py, test/test_acp_deepseek_backend_vault.py. **Goal:** On Windows, a provider key mapping for the DeepSeek Harness cannot name one of Kiro Crew's own variables by spelling it in a different letter case. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/33724)

workarounds.symptom: App SDK useChatSession stays "loading" forever if the new session never shows in the lookup
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(app-sdk): make useChatSession ready from the slot create returns. Target files: website/src/app-sdk/useChatSession.ts, website/src/i18n/locales/bn.json, website/src/i18n/locales/de.json. **Goal:** An app that creates its chat session with `useChatSession` gets a ready session as soon as the create succeeds, instead of a spinner that never ends. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/35248)

workarounds.symptom: `kirocrew service install` needs sudo; Next steps don't say so and there is no fallback
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: say service install needs sudo and name a no-sudo fallback. Target files: src/kiro_crew/service/linux_install.py, cli.sh, test/test_installer_restart_hint.py. **Goal:** A Linux user without sudo learns from the installer that `kirocrew service install` needs sudo, and a failed install tells them how to keep Kiro Crew running without it. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/33743)

workarounds.symptom: Remote crew diagnosis, git divergence and the embeddings pip check kill their child only on timeout, so a cancel (instance edit, gateway shutdown) leaves the ssh or git child running
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: kill a probe, git or pip child when its call is cancelled. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/memory_embeddings.py, src/kiro_crew/git_divergence.py, src/kiro_crew/instances/diagnostics.py. **Goal:** A cancelled remote crew diagnosis, update-check git count or embeddings pip run stops its child process instead of leaving it running with no owner. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/34496)

workarounds.symptom: Spawn refused with the parent agent named when an unrelated project agent spec does not parse
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(subagent): name the unreadable spec files when a spawn is refused fail-closed. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/handlers/messaging.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/messaging_api/spawn.py, src/kiro_crew/subagent.py. `parent_spawn_allowlists` answers `None` when no readable spec declares the parent agent's name and some spec file in the agents directory cannot be read. `_vet_parent_available_agents` then refuses the spawn. The refusal names only the parent agent, for example "the parent agent 'kirocrew' spec could not... (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/31462)

workarounds.symptom: deploy_artifact never offers the human override for a scan block, and drops refusal hints
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(deploy): let deploy_artifact read the route's scan block and hints. Target files: src/kiro_crew/mcp_core_parts/gateway.py, src/kiro_crew/mcp_tools/artifacts.py, test/conftest.py. **Goal:** When a deploy is refused, the `deploy_artifact` tool tells the agent what actually happened: a scan block it can hand to a person to override, a hard block with its reason, or a refusal with its retry hint and command. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/34648)

workarounds.symptom: Cron-born chat tabs vanish on every gateway restart: restore reads dashboard_cron-<id>.jsonl, a name never written
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(dashboard): restore cron chat tabs by their written transcript name. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_utils.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_utils_slots.py, test/test_cron_slot_restore_name.py. **Goal:** Keep cron-born chat tabs in the sidebar across a gateway restart instead of silently dropping them. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/31309)

workarounds.symptom: bug(taskq): a cancel during a runner handle's done/fail write drops the write and leaks its lane slot
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(taskq): settle the runner handle a cancel interrupts before the body runs. Target files: src/kiro_crew/taskrunner_parts/run_steps.py, src/kiro_crew/taskrunner_parts/taskq_bridge.py, src/kiro_crew/workflows/agent_pool.py. After `RunnerAdmission.admit` hands back a handle, both runner consumers awaited writes before entering the `try` whose `CancelledError` arm cancels the handle: (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/28243)

workarounds.symptom: Flaky: test_the_scan_is_linear_not_quadratic fails its 0.5s wall-clock bound on a loaded runner
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(chat): answer /clear locally on the claude harness. Target files: src/kiro_crew/agent_sdk/backends_turns.py, src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_turn/slash_commands.py, test/test_slash_command_no_channel.py. **Goal:** `/clear` on a Claude Code chat clears the conversation the way it does on every other harness: the agent forgets, the todo pill goes and the "Conversation cleared" row shows. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/30080)

workarounds.symptom: Observability: record what a cut turn was waiting on, and why a Stop or send did nothing
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(dashboard): record usage for a turn ended before EVENT_COMPLETE. Target files: src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_runner.py, test/test_abnormal_turn_usage_row_15013.py, test/test_turn_duration_recorded.py. **Goal:** A chat turn that ends abnormally (the 6-hour turn ceiling, the Stop button, or another recovery path) records its credits in the usage store, instead of billing zero. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/15878)
